Definition: from G1515; to be (act) peaceful:--be at (have, live in) peace, live peaceably.
BiblicalUsage: This word means to be at peace or to live peaceably, and the New Testament uses it as a command, not a wish. Jesus says to have salt in yourselves and be at peace with one another, Paul says to live peaceably with all men if it is possible, and he tells the Corinthians to be of good comfort, be of one mind, and live in peace. Peace is something to do, not only something to feel.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe peace with others is part of peace with God, because the same gospel that reconciles me to Him reconciles me to my brother. I hold that I should pursue peace as far as it depends on me, and leave the rest to Him.
